en.headline: High Court opens murder trial of man accused of killing yoga instructor
en.dek: Prosecutors told the jury that Alex Lo bought a knife and planned to kill his former girlfriend Aqua Chow at the Ritz-Carlton in 2022.
body: The High Court on Monday opened the murder trial of Lo Chun-ming, also known as Alex, over the 2022 death of yoga instructor Chow Wai-yin, known as Aqua.

Prosecutors said the pair had been a couple but had already split by the time of the alleged offence, and that Chow had a new boyfriend. They told the jury that Lo bought a knife and planned to kill her at the Ritz-Carlton hotel in West Kowloon on 29 and 30 June 2022. She was found in a hotel room with more than 30 stab wounds.
Lo, who was 28 when charged, faces one count of murder and denies the charge. The case is listed as HCCC 148/2024. The trial continues.

zh.headline: 高等法院開審瑜伽導師遭殺案 被告否認謀殺
zh.dek: 控方告訴陪審團，被告羅俊明購入刀具，計劃於2022年在麗思卡爾頓酒店殺死前女友周慧賢。
body: 高等法院周一開審羅俊明（又名Alex）被控謀殺瑜伽導師周慧賢（又名Aqua）一案。周慧賢於2022年6月底在西九龍麗思卡爾頓酒店房間被發現死亡，身上有超過30處刀傷。
控方表示，兩人曾為情侶，事發前已分手，周慧賢另有男友。控方指羅俊明購入刀具，並計劃於2022年6月29日至30日在酒店將她殺死。羅俊明被控一項謀殺罪，他否認控罪。
